text:
Emily (partnerships): Heads-up — CloudVendor asks for near-real-time usage webhooks (every minute) and an "entitlement_delta" field they can consume to reconcile credits. They want schema locked by EOW. Any blockers?
Raj: minute-level webhooks is doable but we'll need to confirm rate limits and idempotency. also need SKU mapping for their plans.
Anya: agree on idempotency. we'll send a sample payload. does CloudVendor want raw token counts or normalized units?
Mike: they want normalized "units_used" per SKU to map to their billing. also they requested a 30-day backfill CSV for reconciliation.
Sofia: backfill will affect finance systems — we need guaranteed corrected timestamps and a correction flag. also ask for signed CSV checksum.
Emily (partnerships): noted. they also asked for a webhook handshake + HMAC secret per customer.
Raj: we should require a per-customer HMAC and include "event_id" + "sequence" for ordering. idempotency key should be event_id.
Anya: sample JSON we propose:
```
{
  "event_id": "evt_01G8X1ZQK2",
  "sequence": 12345,
  "customer_id": "cv-cust-987",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T12:34:00Z",
  "sku": "redwood-infer.xlarge-token",
  "units_used": 42.7,
  "entitlement_delta": -42.7,
  "correction": false
}
```
This mirrors existing internal usage format but adds entitlement_delta and sequence.
Mike: for contracts — they'll need SLA for webhook delivery (retries + 7-day retention of events). can we support up to 1k req/sec across all customers?
Raj: current system can burst, but sustained 1k/s needs a dedicated ingest queue. we can throttle and provide a 429 with Retry-After header.
Sofia: for reconciliation CSV backfill please include these columns: `event_id,timestamp,customer_id,sku,units_used,entitlement_delta,correction,source_job_id`. checksum: sha256 of file.
Emily (partnerships): CloudVendor also asked for a one-time floating window backfill where corrections are flagged. what format for corrections?
Anya: corrections should be separate records with correction=true and a reference to the original event_id in an extra field `replaces_event_id` (nullable). sample correction row in CSV:
```
event_id,timestamp,customer_id,sku,units_used,entitlement_delta,correction,replaces_event_id
evt_01G8X1ZQK2,2026-02-20T10:00:00Z,cv-cust-987,redwood-infer.xlarge-token,0,-42.7,true,evt_01F7Y9ABC
```
We can add `source_job_id` for traceability.
marketplace-bot: Reminder — add support ticket #INC-4521 created for webhook ingest capacity spike runbook.
Raj: action items: 1) engineering to draft webhook spec + rate-limits (Anya) 2) infra to estimate sustained throughput and queueing (Raj) 3) partnerships to confirm contract SLAs and encryption (Emily) 4) finance to define backfill CSV acceptance tests (Sofia).
Anya: I'll push a PR with the OpenAPI webhook contract and example payloads by tomorrow.
Sofia: I'll write CSV validation rules and two acceptance ETL tests.
Mike: I'll loop in CloudVendor procurement on SLA language and confirm their expected monthly units.
Emily (partnerships): ok, let's aim to close schema by Friday. FYI — CloudVendor wants a sample test webhook endpoint to validate signing, so we should provide a staging endpoint + HMAC secret per test account.
Raj: staging endpoint is fine. we'll also add header `X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=...` and `X-Redwood-Event` for type.
Emily (partnerships): great — thanks all. I'll post the partner contact + initial contract terms in this thread once I have them. :thumbsup:
